title: Sharplink button
description: Square 34px buttons in narrow uppercase type, made of a label box and a separate square arrow box 2px away. The main one is a solid box with a blue arrow box that slides across to the left on hover while the label shifts right (0.5s, easeInOutCirc); tinted ones deepen from 10% to 18% fill in 0.25s.
notes: solid uses foreground / background, so it reads light on dark sections and dark on light ones
renders an <a> when given href, otherwise a <button>
